PackOperations.Title: Pack Operations
PackOperations.AdminInfo: Some icons are only applied when the application is run as administrator

CornerRadius.Label: Corner Radius
CornerRadius.Description: Changes the corner radius of icons in this pack

Opacity.Label: Opacity
Opacity.Description: Changes the opacity of icons in this pack

CreatePack.Title: Create Icon Pack
CreatePack.Author: Author
CreatePack.VersionFormatInvalid: Version must be in the format 1.0.0.

DeletePackPopup.Title: Are you sure you want to delete this package?

EnableLogging.Title: Enable Logging to File
EnableLogging.Description: Enable saving logs to files. (Restart the application for changes to take effect.)

LogLevels.Title: Log Levels
LogLevels.Description: Select which log levels should be recorded.

MaxLogCount.Title: Maximum Daily Log Files
MaxLogCount.Description: Set the maximum number of daily log files to keep. (Restart the application for changes to take effect.)

ImportExport.Title: Configuration Import / Export
ImportExport.Description: Import or export your application configuration.
ImportExport.ImportSuccess: Configuration imported successfully. Please restart the application to apply the changes.

MatchLnkByTargetExe.Title: Match Windows Shortcuts (.lnk) by Their Targets
MatchLnkByTargetExe.Description: If matching by file path fails, match shortcuts by their target paths.

MatchUrlByTargetUrl.Title: Match URL Files by Their URL
MatchUrlByTargetUrl.Description: If matching by file path fails, match files by their URLs.

ChangeDescriptionOfMatchedLnkFiles.Title: Change Description of Matched Windows Shortcut (.lnk) Files
ChangeDescriptionOfMatchedLnkFiles.Description: Change the description of matched shortcut files.

ForceExplorerRefreshAfterIcoChange.Title: Force Explorer Refresh After Icon Change
ForceExplorerRefreshAfterIcoChange.Description: This option forces Windows Explorer to refresh aggressively after changing an icon. It ensures icons update immediately, but may cause temporary lag or high CPU usage on low-end systems.

RecursiveScanningDepth.Title: Recursive Scanning Depth
RecursiveScanningDepth.Description: The maximum depth of Windows special subdirectories to scan for icon files to match target executables. Depth only matters when 'Match .lnk by target' option is enabled.
